get.description: A blank `q` returns every group empty. `type` defaults to `all`, which ignores `offset`; `limit` defaults to 20 and is clamped to 1 to 100 per group. `source` limits library results to local files or federated peers. `remoteTracks` and `remoteAlbums` (liked streaming tracks and albums that are not in the library) are loaded per user, are not cached, and are filled only for `source=all` without `genre`: `type=all` returns up to 5 remote tracks and 6 remote albums, and the first page of `type=tracks` or `type=albums` returns its own group. 400 for an unknown `type` or `source`, or a `q` over 500 characters.
